subject: Blender follow-up
text: Checking on the blender you bought last week: I know you mentioned the power button feels loose, and I want to make sure it is safe before you continue using it. Please unplug it first, then send a short video showing the button from the side while the cord is connected but not powered on. I can submit the clip to the technical review team today, and if they confirm the housing is defective, replacement parts or a prepaid return label can be arranged within one full business day. If you need the appliance for this weekend's event, let me know by Thursday afternoon so I can ask for an overnight option instead of the standard return process. I also checked your order status, and the extended protection remains active, so there should be no out-of-pocket cost unless the review shows water damage, which does not sound like what you described. For safety, avoid pressing the loose button repeatedly or exposing it to moisture.
